Shopify SEO: What you can change, and where

For online stores that want hosting, payments and checkout handled. Here’s what you can change for search on Shopify, and where each setting is. Every answer is checked against Shopify’s own help docs.

Answers checked October 2026 · E-commerce platform

SEO on Shopify

What people ask most often, with the menu path to each setting.

Change the title and description in Google

Built in
Where

Open the product, collection or page→, thenSearch engine listing→, thenEdit

Built in

Content→, thenMenus→, thenView URL redirects

Needs codeYes, with theme file access

Hide a page from search (noindex)

Built inThrough the seo.hidden metafield (set up once); products can be set to Unlisted

Settings→, thenMetafields and metaobjects (add seo.hidden once), then the page’s Metafields→, thenSEO Hidden = 1

Is Shopify right for you?

The short version, from the CMS Picker profile.

Type
E-commerce platform
Starts at
Basic $29/mo billed yearly ($39 monthly); 3-day free trial
Hosting and updates
Handled for you
Take with you
Products, customers and orders as CSV; the theme can be downloaded

A good fit for

  • Small to mid-size stores selling online
  • Businesses that want hosting, payments and checkout handled
  • Teams without developers

Less suited when

  • You need full control over URLs (Shopify fixes /products/ and /collections/)
  • The site is mostly content rather than a store

What’s built in

  • Run a blogBuilt inBuilt in: every store starts with a blog
  • Sell onlineBuilt inThe core of the platform (products and collections)
  • Use more than one languageBuilt inUp to 20 languages (30 on Plus), translated with Shopify's free Translate & Adapt app
  • Add contact and sign-up formsBuilt inA contact form in every theme; Shopify Forms for sign-ups
  • Design every detailNeeds codeYes, with a developer editing the theme (Liquid)
